title: ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to the proposed Seventh Amendment to Concession Agreement…
text:
[Council File 15-1198-S3]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
ADMINISTRATIVE EXEMPTION and COMMUNICATION FROM THE BOARD OF AIRPORT COMMISSIONERS relative to the proposed Seventh Amendment to Concession Agreement LAA-8562 and Ninth Amendment to Ground Lease LAA-8562-1 with Authorized Taxicab Supervision Inc. for taxicab staging and management services at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. CONCUR with the Board of Airport Commissioners' action on September 23, 2026, in finding that the proposed amendments are administratively exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Article II, Section 2(f) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines.
2. APPROVE Board of Airport Commissioners Resolution No. 28461 authorizing the Seventh Amendment to Concession Agreement LAA-8562 and Ninth Amendment to Ground Lease LAA-8562-1 with Authorized Taxicab Supervision Inc., extending their respective terms for up to 12 months for taxicab staging and management services at 9301 South Jetway Boulevard near LAX, and modifying the Airport Taxicab Rate for the duration of the amendments.
3. CONCUR with the action taken by the Board of Airport Commissioners on September 23, 2026, by Resolution No. 28461, authorizing the Chief Executive Officer, Los Angeles World Airports, or designee, to execute said amendments, subject to approval by the City Council and approval as to form by the City Attorney.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The Board of Airport Commissioners reports that the proposed amendments will generate approximately $268,983.12 in monthly revenue from taxicab operations and ground lease payments. There is no impact to the General Fund. The City Administrative Officer and Chief Legislative Analyst have not completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
(Trade, Travel and Tourism Committee waived consideration of the above matter.)
TIME LIMIT FILE - NOVEMBER 13, 2026

outcome.text: Council action: Adopted (Nov 6, 2026); Council action final
